game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: EeveeLikesToast
quote:
Okay, so this is just genuiely my unbiased review. 

As someone who has been playing games their whole life, since I was like 4. I think this game deserves all the praise it gets. Like, what were you expecting from a GTA title? It's like every other GTA title but with SO much more to do. Story isn't groundbreaking but I find it more enjoyable than GTA V's story. 

The graphics, the music, the NPCS and side quest interactions, etc. It's all really done well and amazing. The ONLY critique I genuinely have is that it's currently 30 fps. It's not enough if a complaint to lower the score for me though, as 30 fps just never bothers me. Brother, I can sweat with 30 fps in a shooter unlike most people and still dominate. It's just not a big deal to me. 

A lot of people are saying it's a buggy mess, and I'm 15+ hours in and haven't encountered a bug so I can't speak much on that. No, I don't care that the prostitution is removed. I'm not gooning to clothed characters saying cringe lines while the controller vibrates anyway lmao. 

Besides, the strip clubs are still there and you can still touch all over the models and they will fully remove their tops if you tip enough. This game is legit GTA but improved upon and they even brought back the health and body system from San Andreas. Which most people wanted back, although I see some people complaining about that for some reason? 

"Waited 13 years. Was just expecting more" 

Brother.. WHAT more were you expecting from GTA? This game has delivered and even exceeded my expectations a bit. It's a great game. If you enjoyed any of the 3D era GTA games and don't mind the 30 fps. This game is worth checking out.
